title: Create Aeronautics Expanded | Core
description: All the best add-ons of create Aeronautics ! Focused on Create Aeronautics only. Updates regularly !
body:
This modpack add all the best add-ons of Create Aeronautics to guarantee the best in-game experience ! Compared to other create modpacks, **this one focus on create an only create**: it's easier to understand and it's lighter!

**Not biger; better. The core, the ultimate base for a good Create Experience.**

### What does it add ? And why you should install it:
### 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

It adds new ores, weapons, blocks (like thrusters for example), decorations, functionnalities and much more.

  Big cannons, Create: The Air war, Create Propulsion: Simulated, Radars, JetPack | _**===== Perfect for warships, planes, jets, rockets and others ! ========**_

World Edit, Create: copycats and Create: copycats weighted | _**make realistic builds with beautiful textures & shapes**_
 
Create: Deco, Create: Craft & additions, Create: Diesel Generators, Create: interiors | _**Expand your technology empire and decorate your creations !**_

Aeronautics Camera sync, Gyro Stabilizer, Tweaked controllers, Liquid Fuel, Create: Connected | _**Small tweaks that will enhance your experience with little but important details.**_

Contain various compat mods for storage and popular mods.


</details>

**Why "| Core" ?**

Because it is compatible with almost every create schematic, and you can add more mods over this modpack to realize your desires !

**Informations**

You need to install the modpack on both serveur & client side to make it work. Some mods are customizable.

For any suggestions or to report bugs, go to my [Discord serveur](https://discord.gg/JjZfVHQ8Zy). I will update this project sometimes.

The name "Create Aeronautics Expanded | Core", Logo and branding are reserved. ( Don't use the exact same logo and name, be creative.)

**Important !**

All credits goes to actual owners of each mod.

This modpack includes many excellent mods created by talented developers. Please support the original creators on Modrinth and their project pages. 

This license applies only to original files of the modpack (configs, scripts, documentation, custom assets and other). Included third-party mods remain property of their respective authors under their own licenses.

**Do NOT reupload this modpack** to other places like curseforge, it will be taken down.

Thanks to [FancyMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/fancymenu) that I used for the custom menu.
Special thanks to the Minecraft modding community.
